description: This file contains build definitions and device configurations for the Chromium OS project, specifically for the ipq806x target platform. It includes build rules, device-specific parameters, and external utility invocations related to Chromium OS image creation and device setup.

methods.name: Build/cros-gpt
methods.description: Creates a temporary GPT partition image for Chrome OS kernel and rootfs.

methods.name: Build/append-kernel-part
methods.description: Appends the kernel image to the device's storage image.

methods.name: Build/cros-vboot
methods.description: Runs the Chrome OS verified boot utility to sign the image with the specified kernel.

methods.name: Device/OnhubImage
methods.description: Defines device-specific parameters and images for the OnHub device using Qualcomm IPQ8064 SOC.

methods.name: Device/asus_onhub
methods.description: Device configuration for ASUS OnHub SRT-AC1900.

methods.name: Device/tplink_onhub
methods.description: Device configuration for TP-Link OnHub AC1900 Cloud Router.
